verified_facts.text: The hotel is about 90 minutes from Bordeaux, in the heart of the Charente region.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 90 minutes from Bordeaux, the Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa welcomes you to a place where time seems to stand still, in the heart of the magnificent Charente region.

verified_facts.text: The Chais Monnet site dates from 1838 and is listed as a French industrial heritage site.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Chais Monnet, dating from 1838, i.e. twenty years earlier, is listed as a French industrial heritage site.

verified_facts.text: Architect Didier Poignant transformed the former industrial site into the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: The architect Didier Poignant, transformed the industrial site into a hotel

verified_facts.text: The site's historic features include the Grand Chai des Foudres, known as the Cathedral, with its remarkable framework.
verified_facts.excerpt: the "Grand Chai des Foudres", known as the "Cathedral", with its remarkable framework

verified_facts.text: A glass space links the four cellars and houses the hotel's main reception functions.
verified_facts.excerpt: linking the four cellars by a glass space, where all the hotel's main reception functions are now housed

verified_facts.text: The hotel's gardens are the work of landscape designer Louis Benech.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel's gardens, sublimated by the talent of renowned landscape designer Louis Benech

verified_facts.text: The rooms and suites are spread over four buildings and decorated in a classic French chic style.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread over four buildings, the 92 rooms and suites are decorated in a classic French chic style.

verified_facts.text: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has privileged access to a private treatment room for massages by the spa therapists.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ultimate refinement, our suite offers privileged access to a private treatment room where our guests can enjoy a massage by one of our SPA therapists.

verified_facts.text: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite has a grand reception room, a dining area and cooking facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Jean Gabriel Monnet Suite offers guests a grand reception room, dining area and cooking facilities

verified_facts.text: The hotel also offers fully equipped apartments in a separate building.
verified_facts.excerpt: Housed in a separate building, Hotel Chais Monnet & Spa offers four contemporary one-bedroom apartments

verified_facts.text: The spa has an indoor and outdoor pool, a jacuzzi, saunas, steam rooms, experience showers and a fitness center.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Spa is a true invitation to relaxation and well-being with its indoor and outdoor pool, jacuzzi, saunas, steam rooms, experience showers, four treatment rooms, and fitness center.

verified_facts.text: The pool has large floor-to-ceiling windows that let in natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: Large floor-to-ceiling windows let in natural light and create a soothing space perfect for rest.

verified_facts.text: Spa body treatments use Kos Paris products based on rare plants grown in an environmentally friendly way.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa offers a selection of body treatments using Kos Paris products, based on rare plants, grown in an environmentally friendly way.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Nougatine treatments for children aged 3 to 12.
verified_facts.excerpt: These natural, gourmet-perfumed treatments from Nougatine, for children aged 3 to 12, are adapted to the specific needs of their delicate skin.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop of Bar 1838 overlooks the city of Cognac.
verified_facts.excerpt: Perched above Cognac, the rooftop of Bar 1838 offers an exceptional view of the city.

verified_facts.text: Bar 1838 offers a cocktail masterclass where guests create their own cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover some of the secrets of mixology, and create your own unique creation during our cocktail masterclass.

verified_facts.text: La Distillerie brasserie serves from breakfast to dinner every day.
verified_facts.excerpt: From an elegant breakfast to a dinner inspired by the great French tradition, La Distillerie welcomes you every day in a warm and friendly atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Elegant attire is required at Les Foudres; casual or sportswear is not permitted.
verified_facts.excerpt: elegant attire is required. Casual or sportswear is not permitted.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hôtel Chais Monnet & Spa is pet-friendly!

verified_facts.text: The nearby historic Maison Monnet building houses the Monnet art gallery with original works by Emmanuel Pierre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within it, the Monnet art gallery and the original works of Emmanuel Pierre come to life.

verified_facts.text: The site is named for the Monnet cognac house, and Jean Monnet began his professional career there.
verified_facts.excerpt: Monnet, a reference to Jean Monnet, the world-famous Cognac winegrower who began his professional career here.

verified_facts.text: The sea front and sandy beaches of Charente-Maritime are a short drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: with the sea front and sandy beaches only a short drive away

verified_facts.text: The pool will be closed from January 4 to 10, 2027 for annual maintenance.
verified_facts.excerpt: the pool will be closed on an exceptional basis from January 4 to 10, 2027, for its annual maintenance

verified_facts.text: The rooftop closes for the winter season, when Bar 1838 welcomes guests instead.
verified_facts.excerpt: Please note that during the winter season, Bar 1838 takes over from the Rooftop to welcome you.

verified_facts.text: Several times a month, Bar 1838 hosts evening events exploring its partner cognac houses.
verified_facts.excerpt: a series of evening events dedicated to exploring its partner cognac houses

verified_facts.text: At the Camus cognac house, guests can create their own cognac and leave with a personalized bottle.
verified_facts.excerpt: create your own unique cognac and leave with your own personalized bottle to share with your friends

verified_facts.text: The hotel appeared in the Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2023.
verified_facts.excerpt: Readers' Choice Awards 2023
